title: He Tried to Buy a Fighter Jet With Pepsi Points

lines.text: This college kid found a way to buy a $20 million fighter jet… for $700,000.
lines.tts: This college kid found a way to buy a twenty million dollar fighter jet... for seven hundred grand.

lines.text: The loophole? A Pepsi ad, showing a teen landing a Harrier jet at school.
lines.tts: The loophole? A Pepsi ad... showing a teen landing a Harrier jet at school.

lines.text: Sure beats the bus.
lines.tts: Sure beats the bus!

lines.text: Price: seven million Pepsi Points.
lines.tts: Price? Seven MILLION Pepsi Points.

lines.text: Dude. You'd have to drink Pepsi forever.
lines.tts: Dude. You'd have to drink Pepsi... forever.

lines.text: But John? He read the fine print. Extra points cost… ten cents each. Seven million times ten cents… seven hundred grand. For a jet worth over twenty million. That's a 96% discount. Not even Black Friday goes that hard.
lines.tts: But John? He read the fine print. Extra points cost... ten cents each. Seven million times ten cents... seven hundred grand. For a jet worth over twenty million. That's a ninety-six percent discount. Not even Black Friday goes that hard.

lines.text: Class, this is arbitrage: buy something cheap that's worth way more somewhere else.
lines.tts: Class, this is arbitrage. Buy something cheap... that's worth way more somewhere else.

lines.text: This is insanity.
lines.tts: This is insanity.

lines.text: So he lined up five investors.
lines.tts: So he lined up five investors.

lines.text: Where do we park it?
lines.tts: Where do we park it?

lines.text: …School?
lines.tts: School?

lines.text: And he mailed Pepsi a check for $700,008.50. He even paid the shipping. What is he, a criminal?
lines.tts: And he mailed Pepsi a check for seven hundred thousand and eight dollars... and fifty cents. He even paid the shipping. What is he, a criminal?

lines.text: Pepsi said the jet was a joke.
lines.tts: Pepsi said the jet was a joke.

lines.text: It's a commercial, kid.
lines.tts: (laughing) It's a commercial, kid!

lines.text: They sent the check back… with coupons for free Pepsi. Which, to be fair, gets him a few points closer.
lines.tts: They sent the check back... with coupons for free Pepsi. Which, to be fair, gets him a few points closer.

lines.text: So he sued. And a federal judge ruled no reasonable person would believe a soda company sells fighter jets.
lines.tts: So he sued. And a federal judge ruled... no reasonable person would believe a soda company sells fighter jets.

lines.text: Unreasonable person, right here.
lines.tts: Unreasonable person, right here!

lines.text: He lost. Somewhere, a school bus driver sighed with relief.
lines.tts: He lost. Somewhere... a school bus driver sighed with relief.

lines.text: But Pepsi quietly re-aired the ad. Same jet. New price: seven HUNDRED million points. That's a 9,900% price hike. Worst inflation in history. Plus two tiny words underneath…
lines.tts: But Pepsi quietly re-aired the ad. Same jet. New price? Seven HUNDRED million points. That's a nine thousand nine hundred percent price hike. Worst inflation in history. Plus two tiny words underneath...

lines.text: "Just kidding."
lines.tts: Just kidding.

lines.text: …So we're keeping the cans?
lines.tts: So... we're keeping the cans?
